capacityBasis: Microsoft lists VM RAM in GiB and local NVMe disk capacity in decimal GB. 150 Redis primaries x 16 GiB = 2,400 GiB = 2.5769803776 decimal TB. Three full Lavik copies on three 3.84 TB VMs provide a 3.84 TB single-copy capacity basis. Both denominators are before engine overhead and operational free-space reserve.
